# Company Information

# Contact Information

# Services Offered
1. Expressfahrten (Express Trips)
   - Fast, urgent shipments delivered directly
   - No detours, minimal waiting time

2. Direkt- & Sonderfahrten (Direct & Special Trips)
   - Individual direct trips, door to door
   - No intermediate stops

3. Paket- und Dokumententransporte (Parcel & Document Transport)
   - Safe, punctual delivery of parcels and documents
   - Suitable for businesses and private customers

4. ADR-Gefahrguttransporte (ADR Hazardous Goods Transport)
   - Certified transport of dangerous goods under ADR regulations
   - Trained drivers, full documentation

5. Zeitkritische Spezialtransporte (Time-Critical Special Transport)
   - Highest priority for urgent, sensitive shipments

6. Transport bis 3,5t (Transport up to 3.5 tonnes)
   - Flexible capacity for small to medium loads

7. Deutschlandweite Zustellung (Nationwide Delivery)
   - Reliable delivery throughout Germany

# Key Features
- Fast, reliable, and secure delivery ("Schnell. Sicher. Zuverlässig.")
- Fully insured transport
- ADR-certified hazardous goods handling
- Personal, owner-led service
- Nationwide coverage

# Partner Companies
LM Express works as a trusted subcontractor for established courier and logistics providers, including Transoflex, GO! Express & Logistics, and DPD.

# Target Customers
- Businesses needing courier and express delivery
- Companies requiring ADR hazardous goods transport
- Logistics companies needing reliable subcontracted drivers
- Private customers with urgent shipments

# Company Values
- Reliability: On-time delivery and transparent communication
- Quality: Careful handling and certified processes
- Partnership: Long-term relationships with clients and logistics partners
- Passion: Dedicated to fast, secure delivery
